cues.text: Daytime. The old brick dormitory stands among newer buildings.
Two black cars wait at the curb out front.
Sneakers step down the front stairs.
Small hands grip a green tote bag.
Akihiko, in a white coat, looks up at the dorm.
Mitsuru, arms folded.
Long black boots walk down the steps.
Koromaru runs by.
In the dim lobby, Aigis stands alone at the open door.
She looks back into the empty room.
She shuts the door. In her hand, an old brass key.
Outside, she studies the key.
She locks the front door.
She stands a moment at the tall doors.
From above, she walks down the steps, then looks back up at the building.
Aigis's eyes widen.
Junpei grins, beside Ken.
Mitsuru, Akihiko and Fuuka wait. Koromaru pants happily.
Yukari holds out her hand.
Aigis lays her hand in Yukari's. White light fills the picture.
